subject: CTE Program Admissions Lottery Policy
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a new lottery-based admissions policy for Career and Technical Education (CTE) programs, reviewed a plan to deploy paraprofessionals as bus monitors, and passed a resolution formalizing student representative participation on the committee agenda.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included bills, payrolls, capital purchases, grants, field trips, meeting minutes, and donations.

items.title: Mustang Moment
items.summary: Students from the Career and Technical Education (CTE) program shared their personal experiences and future goals in various vocational pathways.

items.title: CTE Lottery Report and Admissions Policy
items.summary: Approved the first reading of the Chapter 74 Program Admissions Policy to implement a straight lottery system for oversubscribed vocational programs, and voted to waive the second reading.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Update
items.summary: Approved the projected $35,000 budget and received an operational update on student projects from the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility (CCSR).

items.title: Bus Monitor Reports
items.summary: Received a report detailing a tiered approach to using Schedule A paraprofessionals as intermittent, rotating bus monitors on afternoon routes.

items.title: Resolution on Feasibility Study Meeting Invitations
items.summary: Approved a resolution to invite newly elected city council members to attend the school committee meeting presenting the school feasibility study design firm.

items.title: Resolution on Student Representative Agenda Participation
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to designate an agenda block for student representative presentations and establish a quarterly rotation for committee members to observe student council meetings.
